name: wayfinder
description: WayFinder / 寻径 AI-native browser MVP

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @wayfinder/contracts --fail-if-no-match run build && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/web --fail-if-no-match run build && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/server --fail-if-no-match run build
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run schema:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:production-smoke && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs tests --max-warnings=0 && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/contracts --fail-if-no-match run lint && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/web --fail-if-no-match run lint && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/server --fail-if-no-match run lint
scripts.test: pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/contracts --fail-if-no-match run test && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/web --fail-if-no-match run test && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/server --fail-if-no-match run test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/contracts --fail-if-no-match run typecheck && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/web --fail-if-no-match run typecheck && pnpm --filter @wayfinder/server --fail-if-no-match run typecheck
